recipe.name: Bamboo Cocktail
garnish: Green Olive on a Cocktail Pick
directions: Stir all of the ingredients with ice until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled glass. Twist the citrus peel over the drink and place in the glass. Thread a green olive (if using) on a cocktail pick, and balance on the rim of the glass.
NoteA French dry vermouth, fino sherry, and Angostura bitters work well here.
